title: Asset corpus registry entry set
description: Contract for the generated asset registry: deterministic POSIX-sorted entries identifying worktree asset bytes. Hashes identify worktree bytes and are distinct from the baseline Git-blob hashes in legacy-manifest.json. Symbol, dimension, frame, and conversion fields belong to later M4 slices and are not stubbed here.

result.description: Build outcome marker; only successful builds write outputs.

inputs.description: Enumeration inputs: included extensions and excluded directory prefixes.

counts.description: Corpus totals: file count, byte total, per-extension and per-directory-class counts.

entries.description: Registry entries in exact POSIX path order.
